blind.description: A tabletop mechanical orrery featuring a turned dark-wood circular pedestal base, a central brass cog-and-gear body with a hand-crank handle, and a tall central pillar supporting a large orange sphere representing the sun. Multiple curved brass arms branch outward at varying heights and radii, supporting smaller planetary spheres in cream, dark maroon, and terracotta. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, and cleanly modeled with no holes, shards, or floating pieces.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a concentric mechanical system centered on the large bright orange sphere, surrounded by the cogged brass rim and radiating brass arms carrying colored spherical planets at different angles, with a hand crank jutting out to one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2 feet tall (about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide across the outermost arms.
